Fold sentinels and representation errors retain their declared API meaning; no fake finite caustic density or stopped-particle direction is admitted.
Tests cover the declared controls and actual12 saved coordinate pairs; no new M0475002 full angular law, event rate, experimental normalization or physical covariance is inferred.

Measured CPU/wall envelopes exclude preparation, source access, model and network IO; no end-to-end cost claim.
